name: outlook-desktop-mcp
description: Email, calendar, tasks and To-Do in your local Outlook — no Graph API, no app registration.
long_description: Drives the Outlook Desktop app already signed in on this computer: Classic Outlook on Windows through COM, Outlook for Mac through AppleScript. Outlook must be running. The new Outlook (olk.exe) is not supported.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all Outlook accounts (stores) configured in the profile.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email using the user's Outlook account.

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Save an email as a draft in Outlook's Drafts folder without sending.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List drafts currently saved in Outlook's Drafts folder.

tools.name: read_draft
tools.description: Read the full content of a specific draft.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send an existing draft from Outlook's Drafts folder.

tools.name: list_emails
tools.description: List recent emails from a specified Outlook folder.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read the full content of a specific email.

tools.name: mark_as_read
tools.description: Mark a specific email as read in Outlook.

tools.name: mark_as_unread
tools.description: Mark a specific email as unread in Outlook.

tools.name: move_email
tools.description: Move an email to a different Outlook folder.

tools.name: move_by_filter
tools.description: Move every item in a folder that matches a DASL filter, in bulk.

tools.name: reply_email
tools.description: Reply to an email in Outlook.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List mail folders in the user's Outlook mailbox.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search for emails in Outlook using text, sender and/or a raw DASL filter.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List upcoming calendar events from Outlook.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Read the full details of a specific calendar event.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a personal calendar appointment (no attendees).

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List all calendar folders available in an account.

tools.name: create_meeting
tools.description: Create a meeting and send invitations to attendees.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Update an existing calendar event.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event or cancel a meeting.

tools.name: respond_to_meeting
tools.description: Respond to a meeting invitation (accept, decline, or tentative).

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search for calendar events by keyword.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks from the Outlook Tasks folder or one of its task lists.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Read the full details of a specific task.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task in Outlook.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update an existing task.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task as complete.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task from Outlook.

tools.name: list_todo
tools.description: List the Outlook To-Do List: tasks plus emails and contacts flagged for follow-up, sorted by due date (undated items last).

tools.name: flag_email
tools.description: Flag an email for follow-up so it appears in the To-Do List.

tools.name: clear_flag
tools.description: Remove an email's follow-up flag, or mark it complete.

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List all attachments on an email or calendar event.

tools.name: save_attachment
tools.description: Save an attachment from an email or event to disk.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all available Outlook categories.

tools.name: set_category
tools.description: Set categories on an email, event, or task.

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: List all mail rules in Outlook.

tools.name: toggle_rule
tools.description: Enable or disable a mail rule by name.

tools.name: create_rule
tools.description: Create a new incoming-mail rule.

tools.name: get_out_of_office
tools.description: Check the current Out of Office (auto-reply) status.
